notes.title: [Update] Compete with yourself in Imperia Online
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/8d0b2ab1c559069f6c0fd9426033aefa90a1f2ed.jpg

Competing with other players is officially not enough. It’s time for something more.

Greetings Noble Warriors!

Let’s say you have achieved everything in Imperia Online.

You have won all the medals, you have beaten all your enemies, you have conquered all the lands, which can be conquered.

What’s left then?

Well, we have thought about that as well and we came up with the idea that… when your are at the top, the only competition left is… with yourself.

Have you ever wanted to take stock of your glorious achievements as an emperor and get inspired for even more daring feats? This is now available in the new subtab of Net Points tab in Rankings. There you can compare your current results of net worth, military, buildings, researches  and incomes with your performance in another era where you have scored your best results.

Because competing with others is too mainstream anyway!

notes.title: [Update] New achievement system and more!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/834115d6f7c898a3ecdacc04f6ba7b8874a66f38.png

Greetings, noble Emperors!

The new achievement system has come, together with other exciting features:
 
New achievement system 
You can chose to pursue 30 different achievements representing your military and economic power.

Barbarians 2.0
Major changes affecting the barbarian camps density and number of attacks each player can do in a single day.

Global chat
Global chat is available now in all realms. Tell players from all over the world about your recent victory now.

Time to step up your game. Good luck!
